```sql
WITH fy_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE '2025-04-01' AS start_date,
        DATE '2026-03-31' AS end_date
),
paid_social_spend AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(s.spend_local), 0) AS total_ad_spend
    FROM staging.stg_marketing__ad_spend s
    CROSS JOIN fy_dates d
    WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN d.start_date AND d.end_date
      AND s.region_code = 'AU'
      AND LOWER(s.marketing_channel) = 'paid social'
),
attributed_social_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(o.items_subtotal - o.discount_total), 0) AS total_attributed_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    CROSS JOIN fy_dates d
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN d.start_date AND d.end_date
      AND o.region_code = 'AU'
      AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled'
      AND LOWER(o.marketing_channel) = 'paid social'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN s.total_ad_spend = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE r.total_attributed_revenue / s.total_ad_spend
    END AS answer
FROM paid_social_spend s
CROSS JOIN attributed_social_revenue r
```
